rows.text: The reply of the Speaker of the Fale Alea to the Princess Regent's Speech from the Throne ('Ko e tali 'a e Sea 'o e Falealea ki To Folofola mei he Taloni 'a e Pilinisesi Pule') is dated ''Aho 02 'o Sune 2008', refers to the opening of the 108th meeting of the Fale Alea ('Fakataha hono teau-ma-valu') on 29 May 2008 (''aho 29 'o Me 2008'), and is signed 'Tu'ilakepa / Sea 'o e Fale Alea / Mo e Fale Alea 'o Tonga'.
rows.locator: Title; date line; opening paragraph; signature block
rows.uncertainty: A contemporaneous attestation of him as Speaker on the reply's date only; no appointment, start or end date. The source names him only by his noble title. The day 2 May 2008 appears only in IPU's 2008 summary, which the Crown packet holds (to_ipu_2008) and this packet does not cite.

bounded_scope: Speaker observations for CLAUDE-C01-24 only (role to_speaker on the to_legislative_assembly observation).
